name: sgs/mega-aside
title: SGS Mega Aside
description: The optional side panel of a mega panel — media, a heading, text and a call-to-action. Its colours and shape are painted entirely by the parent mega panel's style variant and colour scheme, so switching the panel restyles the aside uniformly. Used inside sgs/mega-panel only.

aside.label: Aside
aside._note: The `.sgs-mega-aside` side-column wrapper. Carries NO styling attributes of its own by design (CF-10, parent-paints-child): the parent sgs/mega-panel's scoped CSS paints this element per data-mega-style / data-mega-scheme (width via asideWidth, divider via asideSeparator — both mega-panel attrs, not this block's). Its content (media + heading + text + button) is child-owned (HC2). Honest zero-cluster element.
